steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: TRIAC load fuse context
steps.body: F500 protects all TRIAC-controlled loads (fill, drain, dispenser, diverter, etc.). If any TRIAC load runs in Service Diagnostics, F500 is OK.
steps.sourceExcerpt: F500 protects all TRIAC-controlled loads (fill, drain, dispenser, diverter, etc.). If any TRIAC load runs in Service Diagnostics, F500 is OK.

steps.title: F500 resistance < 3 Ω?
steps.body: Power off. Measure F500 fuse on control board (accessible from top). Less than 3 Ω = good; greater than 3 Ω = open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Measure F500 fuse on control board (accessible from top). Less than 3 Ω = good; greater than 3 Ω = open.

steps.title: Inspect all TRIAC loads
steps.body: With fuse open, inspect resistance of every TRIAC load for short, open, overheating, or pinched harness. Replace failed parts before replacing control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: With fuse open, inspect resistance of every TRIAC load for short, open, overheating, or pinched harness. Replace failed parts before replacing control.

steps.title: Replace ACU after load repair
steps.body: Replace control if F500 open and all loads check good.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace control if F500 open and all loads check good.

steps.title: F500 OK
steps.body: Triac fuse intact — if loads still dead, check door switch and pilot relay (K2).
steps.oemOutcome: Triac fuse intact — if loads still dead, check door switch and pilot relay (K2).
